Use the uploaded car as the visual reference, preserving its model, proportions, body design, and color. Feature the vehicle prominently at the top. Include the researched variant, research date, and compact source references where space allows. DESIGN RULES: All text must be accurate Persian with correct RTL layout, spelling, and readable typography. Keep information concise but meaningful. Avoid clutter, unsupported claims, unnecessary logos, and watermarks. If the exact variant cannot be identified and significantly affects the findings, ask ONE brief clarification.
